notes: Card: ' COP' x5, 'A' x3 (M61⟦A⟧1), '5' x2 of the top 32; the pole's output promotes digits and numerals (' III', '6', ' five', ' seven'). Probes: ' COP' 0.42-0.50 in three sentences, M61A2 0.62, M16A1 0.28, M1A2 0.08; ' cop' (police) 0.02, a climate summit without the word 0.03, PS / Apollo / Formula 0.01-0.02. The test claims only the ' COP' token, which is a minority of the top examples, so coverage will be partial.
